post.ref: Baba Sheikh Farid Guru Granth Sahib, Ang 1379
post.meaning: You wasted the day wandering and the night asleep. God will ask what you came here to do.
post.caption:
A Sufi line for a restless heart 🕊️

📖 Baba Sheikh Farid, Guru Granth Sahib, Ang 1379

Save कर लें, मुश्किल दिन में काम आएगा। 🔖

#sufi #sufism #sufiquotes #sufipoetry #spirituality

reel.meaning: What you hold in your heart through life is what you will hold at the end. Begin remembering now.
reel.caption:
कृष्ण की यह बात आज के दिन के लिए है 🦚

📖 Bhagavad Gita, 8.5

अगर यह बात सच लगी, तो अपनों के साथ Share करें। 🙏

#krishna #bhagavadgita #radhekrishna #gita #sanatandharma
